correctness.rationale: For the specified integral determinant normalization of Klein degree-21 invariant K, the polynomial Hessian/Jacobian calculations yield a primitive cyclically invariant K (x^21 coefficient 1), K(G)=K Q42 over Z of degree 63, Q42 degree 42. Direct independent SymPy reconstruction checked integral division by 9 and 14, exact quotient/remainder, and mod3 Q42=K^2. As gradient G reduces to (z^3,x^3,y^3), cyclic invariance and Frobenius give the polynomial identity K(G iterated k) mod3=K^(3^k) for every k>=0, proving scheme-theoretic divisor multiplicities, not just supports. Independent GF(3^6) exact arithmetic verified irreducible factor degrees 3,6,6,6 for t^21-t^7+1, all 21 distinct line factors by coefficient expansion, all 210 line-pair intersections, giving exactly 28 triple and 21 quadruple points and Frobenius degree distribution triple (1:1,3:3,6:24), quadruple (3:3,6:18). Finite incidence check is exhaustive for 21 symbolic factors; it is not an infinite-iterate proof.
